description: The signed-in user's message threads with Boatsite sellers, and the sellers' replies. With no threadId it lists the threads; with one it returns that thread's messages. Enquiries sent with make_enquiry appear here. Needs the user to connect their Boatsite account.

threadId.description: A thread id from the list, or from make_enquiry.

name: get_my_messages
title: My messages
